ara: مُحَمَّدٌ خَيْرُ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلَى قَدَمِ
مُحَمَّدٌ لَمْ يَزَلْ نُورًا مِنَ الْقِدَمِ
مُحَمَّدٌ خَيْرُ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ مِنْ مُضَرٍ
en: Muḥammadun ashrafu l-aʿrābi wa-l-ʿajami
Muḥammadun khayru man yamshī ʿalā qadami
Muḥammadun bāsiṭu l-maʿrūfi jāmiʿuhu
Muḥammadun ṣāḥibu l-iḥsāni wa-l-karami
Muḥammadun tāju rusli Llāhi qāṭibatan
Muḥammadun ṣādiqu l-aqwāli wa-l-kalimi
Muḥammadun thābitu l-mīthāqi ḥāfiẓuhu
Muḥammadun ṭayyibu l-akhlāqi wa-sh-shiyami
Muḥammadun ruwiyat bi-n-nūri ṭīnatuhu
Muḥammadun lam yazal nūran mina l-qidami
Muḥammadun ḥākimun bi-l-ʿadli dhū sharafin
Muḥammadun maʿdinu l-inʿāmi wa-l-ḥikami
Muḥammadun khayru khalqi Llāhi min Muḍarin
Muḥammadun khayru rusli Llāhi kullihimi
Muḥammadun dīnuhu ḥaqqun nadīnu bihi
Muḥammadun mujmilan ḥaqqan ʿalā ʿalami
Muḥammadun dhikruhu rawḥun li-anfusinā
Muḥammadun shukruhu farḍun ʿalā l-umami
Muḥammadun zīnatu d-dunyā wa-bahjatuhā
Muḥammadun kāshifu l-ghummāti wa-ẓ-ẓulami
Muḥammadun sayyidun ṭābat manāqibuhu
Muḥammadun ṣāghahu r-Raḥmānu bi-n-niʿami
Muḥammadun ṣafwatu l-Bārī wa-khīratuhu
Muḥammadun ṭāhirun min sā'iri t-tuhami
Muḥammadun ḍāḥikun li-ḍ-ḍayfi mukrimuhu
Muḥammadun jāruhu wa-Llāhi lam yuḍami
Muḥammadun ṭābati d-dunyā bi-biʿthatihi
Muḥammadun jā'a bi-l-āyāti wa-l-ḥikami
Muḥammadun yawma baʿthi n-nāsi shāfiʿunā
Muḥammadun nūruhu l-hādī mina ẓ-ẓulami
Muḥammadun qā'imun li-Llāhi dhū himamin
Muḥammadun khātamun li-r-rusli kullihimi
Muhammad, the noblest of the Arabs and the non-Arabs.
Muhammad, the best of all who walk on foot.
Muhammad, the bestower of goodness who embodies it all.
Muhammad, the master of excellence and generosity.
Muhammad, the crown of all the Messengers of Allah.
Muhammad, truthful in his words and speech.
Muhammad, steadfast in the covenant and its keeper.
Muhammad, whose character and qualities are good.
Muhammad, whose clay was steeped in light.
Muhammad, a light that has shone since pre-eternity.
Muhammad, the noble judge who rules with justice.
Muhammad, the fountain of generosity and wisdom.
Muhammad, the finest of Allah’s creation from the line of Mudar.
Muhammad, the best of all the Messengers of Allah.
Muhammad, whose religion is the truth that we follow.
Muhammad, exalted and manifest in truth.
Muhammad, whose remembrance brings comfort to our souls.
Muhammad, to whom all nations owe gratitude.
Muhammad, the beauty and delight of this world.
Muhammad, the one who dispels distress and darkness.
Muhammad, a master whose virtues are excellent.
Muhammad, whom the Most Compassionate fashioned with blessings.
Muhammad, the Creator’s Chosen One and His Elect.
Muhammad, pure and free from every accusation.
Muhammad, who smiles at the guest and honours him.
Muhammad, by Allah, whose neighbour was never wronged.
Muhammad, by whose mission the world was made blessed.
Muhammad, who came with signs and wisdom.
Muhammad, our intercessor on the Day mankind is resurrected.
Muhammad, whose light guides us out of darkness.
Muhammad, devoted to Allah and possessed of high resolve.
Muhammad, the Seal of all the Messengers.
